blurb: Located at 4859 S. Wabash Ave, the Charles A. Hayes Family Investment Center (known as "the FIC") is conveniently located in the Bronzeville-Grand Boulevard community. The center is a staple in the community and houses organizations that offer unique services. It was named for Chicago’s late Congressman Charles A.
